Edition compass · Case 04 · Die andere Stadt · Joint version 1.1 · 27 October 2026 · Material

Our recommended strategy

  1. The team starts on a small convoy. oXygen with Git client and a short joint process allow for independent corrections; the technology supports in conflicts.
  2. The Editionsrepo is located in an institutional GitLab project group. Two designated persons can arrange administration and restoration.
  3. A verified basic transcription is taken over in accordance with TEI. Afterwards, this unit is the relevant scientific working version in the Editionsrepo.
  4. Edition data and frontend code are in separate repos. Versioned converters remain in the edition repo at first. Defined exports are in the import archive.
  5. Lukas continues to develop a permanent alternative reconstruction on a designated research stand. Nora maintains additional figure relations in its own annotation repo.
  6. Publications combine released data, schema, frontend and image references. Scientifically relevant typesetting corrections are returned to the TEI in a controlled manner.
  7. In the past, research entries, local data copies, post-editing, institutional responsibility and restoration are regulated.

Concepts of work journeys

Git and Platform

Git captures file versions and its relationships. GitHub and GitLab complement hosting, permissions, discussions, and automated testing processes.

Git Repository, Repo for short

A repo contains files and their Git history. A working repository is used for editing; a publication repository is curated for its readers.

Commit and Transfer

A commit holds a change step locally. Only the transfer to the remote repo makes it available there as well.

Tag, release and archive version

A tag marks a Git-version. A release bundles a deliberately released output with description. An independent archive version receives the inventory with metadata.

Edition data, frontend and interface

The scientifically responsible data carry texts and editorial relationships. The technical front end provides an interface for the development of the digital edition. Interface describes the designed access from a usage perspective.

Examination and technical acceptance

XML well-formedness, schema testing and functional tests test different properties. The editorial acceptance also evaluates the scientific content. A green test does not replace it.

Inspection and expert opinions

Review refers here to an agreed technical or editorial review. An external scientific report has its own mission. GitLab mentions suggestions for amendments Merge Requests, GitHub Pull Requests.

Safety and operation

Regular commits and transfer to a reliably operated Uni-GitLab can be part of a backup strategy. Files outside the repos, recovery, archiving and ongoing service need their own regulations.
